name: Big Calendar
summary: Next.js calendar app template with agenda, year, month, week and day views, drag-and-drop events and user filtering.
description: A responsive event calendar built with Next.js 14, TypeScript, Tailwind, shadcn/ui and date-fns, designed to be copied into your own project with a CalendarProvider and useCalendar hook. Five views, drag-and-drop rescheduling, per-user filtering with avatars, configurable working hours, a live time indicator and dark mode.
contains: five views: agenda, year, month, week, day
event colors and three badge display variants (dot, colored, mixed)
user management: filter by user, avatars and profile integration
configurable working hours and adjustable visible hours range
Next.js 14, TypeScript, Tailwind v3, shadcn/ui, date-fns, React Context
